title: Nike Moon Shoe OG on sale in India: Black/Sail (IX3952-001) ₹8,995 at Superkicks and VegNonVeg; Superkicks 3 colourways all ₹8,995; VegNonVeg lists 12 colourways, 3 at ₹10,995; Nike US $105. The 1972 original: designed by Bill Bowerman for runners at the 1972 Olympic Trials, about 12 pairs made; the only known unworn pair sold at Sotheby's for $437,500 on 23 July 2019, a sneaker auction record at the time; waffle sole idea from his wife's waffle iron.
